description: SYNTHORA NFT Intelligence — everything an agent needs about NFTs in ONE call, multichain (Base/Ethereum/Polygon/Arbitrum/Optimism): ERC-721/ERC-1155 classification via ERC-165, name/symbol/totalSupply, enumerable/metadata/royalty (ERC-2981) support, collection card (contractURI), token owners and resolved metadata (IPFS, Arweave, data URI, HTTPS: name, description, image, traits) for up to 20 token_ids per call, the NFTs a wallet holds, and which of a list of token_ids a wallet owns (works on non-enumerable collections). Replaces 5-20 separate calls. Deterministic: block number and chain id in [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base; first 3 calls free]
